scripts.build:windows: if not exist .env copy .env.example .env && docker compose up --build
scripts.setup: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma migrate reset && docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.prisma:generate: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:db-push: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:db-seed: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:reset: docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma migrate reset && docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma migrate dev && docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma generate && docker exec -it playstation-backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.parser: npm run backend npx tsx scripts/parser.ts
